nodes.name: IsClaudeRetryable
nodes.notes: Retry once on timeout/5xx only. A 4xx is a config fault - retrying wastes money and time (spec 4.2).

nodes.name: ParseClaude
nodes.notes: Backstop only - the API already enforces the schema. Still required for refusal / max_tokens.

nodes.name: IsReplyUsable
nodes.notes: A malformed or refused response must never reach the lead. Silence plus a logged error is recoverable; a broken reply is not.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ client_id: $json.clientId, lead_id: $json.leadId, channel: 'whatsapp', direction: 'outbound', body: $json.parsed.reply, status: $json.sendOk ? 'sent' : 'failed', ai_generated: true, approved_by_human: null, external_id: $json.twilioSid }) }}

nodes.name: PrepRunAI
nodes.notes: No message bodies or PII in payload (spec 4.2).

nodes.name: PrepRunFailed
nodes.notes: Nothing was sent to the lead. Escalation is Checkpoint B3.

nodes.name: PrepRunDuplicate
nodes.notes: Twilio retry - already answered. Must not reply twice.

nodes.name: MergeLeadFields
nodes.notes: The no-backwards rule. A populated field never returns to null. Merges, never assigns.

nodes.name: AfterLeadUpdate
nodes.notes: Reads $('MergeLeadFields') explicitly - $input after an HTTP node is an envelope (lesson 9).

nodes.name: IsNewlyQualified
nodes.notes: Fires on the TRANSITION only. Gated on stageBefore != qualified, so later messages do not re-emit.
